title: Project Open production UI
objective: Add the production caller for the project-open boundary that V0.3-12 built and tested. A new ProjectControls component renders an Open Project action and, on activation, calls the EXISTING openProjectFromNativeDialog(selectProjectDirectory, inspectProject) composition - it does not re-implement selection, inspection, path handling or the Tauri invoke. A successful open is written into the workspace session exactly once, via session.openProject({ projectPath, project }) taken from the composition's own { status: 'opened', projectPath, project } result, character for character. A dismissed picker is control flow, not an error: no session write, no error notice, no side effect. Every failure is classified and rendered as a human-readable message - ProjectDirectoryBridgeError, RuntimeProjectApiError, RuntimeProjectTransportError, RuntimeProjectContractError - reusing the component's own classification, and a structured Runtime failure may surface its stable Runtime code. The component never renders the raw response body, the Runtime URL, a request URL or an unnecessary filesystem diagnostic: the project path and the project id are NOT rendered. It renders the opened project's minimal facts the Runtime declared - displayName, projectId, schemaVersion, updatedAt - and a real no-project state when the session holds none. It reads and writes the session only through the frozen hooks in apps/desktop/src/workspace/, and it renders strings only from the frozen i18n keys under the 'project.' prefix.
scope: The new project controls component and its vitest suite.
non_goals: Re-implementing selectProjectDirectory, inspectProject or openProjectFromNativeDialog - all three stay the single implementations
Any direct fetch, any direct Tauri invoke, or any filesystem API in the component
A global current project, a module-level store, or a second session instance
Recent-projects, project create/rename/delete/repair/upgrade, or any runtime/Rust/IPC change
acceptance_criteria: Activating Open Project calls openProjectFromNativeDialog exactly once and, on { status: 'opened' }, writes exactly that projectPath and that project object into the workspace session
A picker that resolves null produces { status: 'cancelled' }: the session is untouched and no failure is rendered

A ProjectDirectoryBridgeError, a RuntimeProjectApiError, a RuntimeProjectTransportError and a RuntimeProjectContractError are each classified and rendered as a distinct human-readable message, and a RuntimeProjectApiError's stable code is surfaced
No rendered output contains the selected project path, the project id, the Runtime URL, a request URL or a raw response body - including in the failure states
With no project open the component renders its no-project state and offers Open Project; with a project open it renders that project's displayName, projectId, schemaVersion and updatedAt
The component performs no fetch, no direct invoke and no filesystem call
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for the focused vitest run, pnpm test, pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint
Name every new test case and state the RED observation that preceded each new behaviour
State explicitly that no integration surface (App.tsx, DockWorkspace.tsx, DbcWorkspace.tsx, workspace/**, i18n/**), no Rust file and no Runtime file was touched
